title: pmsims
text: pmsims R package estimating much data needed develop reliable generalisable prediction models. uses simulation-based learning curve approach quantify model performance improves increasing sample size, supporting principled study planning feasibility assessment. package fully model-agnostic: users can define data generated, models fitted, predictive performance measured. Built-workflows cover continuous, binary, time--event outcomes, choice regression-based models (linear, logistic, Cox) machine-learning models (regularised regression, random forest, XGBoost).
